statement.essentials: An artery and a vein also run through the gland, deeper than the nerve.
statement.anatomy: The external carotid artery passes deep to the posterior belly of the digastric and enters the gland, lying deep to the retromandibular vein; it divides behind the mandibular neck into the maxillary and superficial temporal arteries.
